meta.note: Fourth measurement pass: adds the mmap'd single-file B+tree engines (LMDB via heed, libmdbx, jammdb) and the per-instance metrics the earlier passes omitted - OS threads, virtual address space, and the empty-bucket disk floor - plus sparse-aware allocated-block disk measurement. Ran on a DISK-BACKED filesystem (/var/tmp, overlay2), not the tmpfs the first three passes used: tmpfs hit ENOSPC at 3.9 GiB and its RAM use is what OOM-killed sled in passes 2-3. Consequently every write figure here is far lower (fsync now costs something) and this pass is NOT comparable record-for-record with passes 1-3 - but it is the first pass covering all eight engines in one internally consistent sweep, and the first in which sled completes. One process per engine, merged by scripts/merge-db-bench-results.py.
